details: Removed animationReady state and the data-animate attribute.
Removed the unconditional 1600ms setTimeout fallback entirely.
Kept IntersectionObserver as the actual entry trigger using isIntersecting, with boundingClientRect.bottom < 0 still fast-forwarding already-past/deep-link positions.
Kept the absent-IntersectionObserver guard committing final visible state.
Kept .trackBar default statically visible at transform: scaleX(1).
Replaced data-animate collapse/transition selectors with a data-entered-triggered keyframe animation from scaleX(0) to scaleX(1).
Preserved the original 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) timing and row stagger.
Updated prefers-reduced-motion selectors so data-entered bars remain final width with no animation.
